svg.title: Recovery uncertainty can reverse the ranking of two schedules
svg.desc: The exact normalized cost difference d(z) equals z times (1-2z) times (1-z squared), divided by 16. It is positive below one half, negative above one half, and zero at zero, one half, and one. Exact values at one quarter and three quarters are 15/2048 and -21/2048. This is an analytical construction, not measured execution cost.
